primarySources.contract: Named template arguments do not retain edge whitespace as part of the passed value. The independent lexical projection is narrower: only literal numeric Page and Volume fields of two pinned native citation families are projected.
Quoted reference identity attribute values are distinct from syntax whitespace before the self-closing slash. No attribute value is decoded, renamed or reordered by this projection.
The native Page/Pages and Volume roles are separately consumed. Competing Page aliases, duplicate supplied keys, nonliteral values and unproved fields are left raw.
Native CS1 consumes these supplied scalar fields without giving their argument edge padding a separate bibliographic identity.

anonymousNativeParseControl.scope: One preauthored fictional citation with literal page and volume edge padding plus a reused quoted self-closing reference. This is a directed native control, not whole-corpus remote rendering.

limitations: Opaque note emitters remain unexpanded and byte-bound. Uncertainty is still reported as uncertainty. The projection does not normalize whole citations or ignore changes to names, groups, titles, URLs, numeric values or other source bytes.
